title: cli help and manual editing guidance for humans and agents
description: The CLI long_about is addressed to AI agents ('first get explicit permission...') and contradicts ARCHITECTURE.md/SPEC.md, which bless jq scripting and 'direct JSON editing as a last resort' for metadata. Manual JSON editing by agents has been a real problem in practice. Rewrite help text so it reads naturally to both humans and agents, and reconcile the manual-editing story across README/ARCHITECTURE/SPEC once the owner reviews ARCH and SPEC: state which files are safe to hand-edit (issue files), which are not (index.json - derivable cache), and what the recovery procedure is. Blocked on: owner review of ARCHITECTURE.md and SPEC.md.
